title: Headcount sync + hiring 1:1 prep (scratchpad) - Maya
content:
Purpose / context:
- Prep notes for 1:1 with Alex (Eng Manager) + weekly headcount sync follow-up. Focus: interview debriefs, offer cadence, and org plan requests for next quarter.

High-level goals:
- Get alignment on top hiring priorities (IC vs. manager, backend infra vs. serving runtime)
- Confirm which reqs can be accelerated (budget + approvals)
- Decide interview loop changes based on recent debriefs (reduce panel overlap, add take-home?)
- Capture action items and owners for recruiter matching / interview scheduling

Current snapshot (quick numbers):
- Open reqs: 12 (serving-runtime: 4, infra: 3, product: 2, platform-eng: 2, people-ops: 1)
- Offers extended: 3 (2 accepted, 1 pending counter)
- Active candidates in pipeline: ~28 (10 in loop, 8 screening, 10 sourcing)
- Time-to-offer (median): 28 days (target 21)
- Budget headcount remaining (FY Q1 allocation): 6 FTEs uncommitted

Candidates of note (from last interview loop) — quick bullets to reference in 1:1:
- Candidate A (Backend infra) — strong systems design, good infra tradeoffs, salary expectation +/- 10% of band. Interviewers flagged: lacks large-scale infra ops experience but rapid learner. Recommendation: move to final with hiring manager interview.
- Candidate B (Serving runtime) — excellent low-level optimization background, poor on cross-team communication scenarios. Panel scored 6.5/10 average. Suggest: skip offer; consider for IC-level role later.
- Candidate C (Platform Eng Sr) — great match, manager + tech lead both recommend. Compensation alignment likely feasible. Good to accelerate.

Interview loop observations / proposed changes:
- Current loop: 1h screen (recruiter), 1h tech screen, 1.5h onsite with 3 interviews (system design, code, behavioural) + hiring manager. Too long; candidates dropping after second round.
- Proposed: shorten onsite to 90m with two focused interviews (design + culture/hire manager), keep separate short coding take-home for specific roles.
- Remove duplicated behavioural questions across panel; provide interviewers with shared rubric snippets (see Confluence link above).
- Consider introducing a "finalist fast-track" for top-tier candidates: manager + tech lead debrief same-day, offer within 48h.

Open questions to raise with Alex in 1:1:
- Which 3 reqs should we prioritize for fast-track this month? (ask for explicit order)
- Is there remaining discretionary budget to convert one contractor headcount this quarter?
- Are we comfortable re-routing one senior hiring manager interview to a peer interview to speed up scheduling?
- Any objections to adding take-home for serving runtime roles?

Risks / constraints:
- Compensation bands are tight for senior infra — may require additional budget or equity sweetener.
- Interviewer bandwidth: offsite schedule in two weeks will reduce available panel slots by ~30%. Need to front-load interviews where possible.
- Org reorg talk: product team might request headcount reallocation next month — mark reqs 5 & 6 as tentative.

Proposed ask / agenda for 1:1 (15-20 min):
- Quick alignment on top 3 priorities (3 min)
- Review Candidate C (recommend accelerate) + decide next step (3 min)
- Confirm fast-track list and approvals needed (5 min)
- Agree on interview loop change proposal and owner to update interview guides (4 min)
- Actions / timeline (2-5 min)

Action items to capture (will assign after 1:1):
- [ ] Confirm prioritization list and update headcount tracker (owner: Alex?)
- [ ] Recruiter to start fast-track outreach to Candidate C and top two sourced matches (owner: Ava)
- [ ] Compensation check for senior infra req — finance loop to approve additional 5% (owner: Ryan)
- [ ] Update interview guides + rubric (owner: Jordan)
- [ ] Schedule follow-up sync next Friday to review offer outcomes and pipeline metrics (owner: Maya)

Notes for debriefs (what to capture post-loop):
- Save verbatim panel feedback + rubric scores in the candidate card (helps calibration).
- Note any red flags that are mitigable via onboarding or mentorship (e.g., lacks scale but strong learning).
- Track decline reasons where possible (comp, timeline, other offers) — feed into sourcing strategy.

Short scripts / prompts for 1:1:
- "If we had 2 hires this month, which roles move the needle most for your roadmap?"
- "Which interviewer(s) should we remove or combine to reduce candidate drop-off?"
- "Any changes to comp philosophy we should consider for hard-to-fill infra roles?"

Sourcing / recruiter notes (things to push):
- Focus on ex-cloud infra pipelines and LLM-serving experience for serving-runtime reqs.
- Try passive outreach to candidates who have open-source infra contributions (kernel-level, CUDA, or runtime libs).
- Leverage referral bonus this month for platform eng.

Misc scratch items / ideas:
- Run a 2-week hiring blitz (3 roles) right after the offsite to take advantage of reduced meeting schedules (requires quick approvals).
- Consider short "project assignment" trial for borderline candidates (2 weeks, contractor) to validate fit before full offer.
- Update "candidate experience" doc with timeline expectations to reduce declines (clearer messaging around time-to-offer).

Prep checklist for today
- [ ] Pull latest headcount tracker + req status (I will do before 11:00am)
- [ ] Bring Candidate C packet (resume, panel notes, comp band)
- [ ] Bring recommendation for which 3 reqs to fast-track
- [ ] Draft short email template for fast-track outreach (for Ava to send)

Post-1:1 follow-up template (for my notes):
- Summary of decisions (1-2 bullets)
- Assigned owners + deadlines
- Immediate next steps (who contacts whom, timeline)
- Add to weekly headcount sync agenda

-- end scratchpad --

(Notes to self: keep this doc informal. Move everything to Confluence after we have alignment; use candidate-specific cards in Greenhouse for feedback and offer letters.)
